# OrderedSearch06.OracleSymmetry

**实际oracle的反周期桥**

Eq (1) 阈值 oracle f_j、Eq (2)-(5) 反周期延拓 g_j、标签与查询位置的半周期反周期性、平移协变，以及与库 oracle ospBit 的对应。

**边界**：仅给出 oracle 函数层面的恒等式；不宣称任意访问模型等价。 Claim还包含等query访问模拟及末态协变，现有函数恒等式不是完整覆盖。

**覆盖等级**：B

| FQN | 种类 | 源码 | 一句话 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Qatlib.Papers.OrderedSearch06.OracleSymmetry.paperF` | def | L38 | The integer comparison sign, equal to −1 when `x < j` and 1 otherwise. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.OrderedSearch06.OracleSymmetry.paperF_succ_eq` | theorem | L42 | For `x ≥ 1`, increasing the comparison threshold by one is equivalent to decreasing the query position by one [ChildsLandahlParrilo2007]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.OrderedSearch06.OracleSymmetry.paperF_zero` | theorem | L52 | For `j ≥ 0`, the comparison sign at position zero and threshold `j + 1` is −1. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.OrderedSearch06.OracleSymmetry.paperG` | def | L58 | The periodic ordered-search sign determined by whether `(x − j) mod (2 * N)` lies in the first half. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.OrderedSearch06.OracleSymmetry.paperG_half_test` | theorem | L63 | For a representative in `[0, 2 * N)`, shifting by `N` exchanges the first-half and second-half tests. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.OrderedSearch06.OracleSymmetry.paperG_neg_half` | theorem | L78 | For positive `N`, the remainder of `−N` modulo `2 * N` is `N`. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.OrderedSearch06.OracleSymmetry.paperG_add_neg_half` | theorem | L87 | Adding `−N` or `N` gives the same remainder modulo `2 * N`. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.OrderedSearch06.OracleSymmetry.paperG_piecewise` | theorem | L95 | On the doubled domain with threshold in the first half, `paperG` equals `paperF` on the first half and its negated translated value on the second half [ChildsLandahlParrilo2007]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.OrderedSearch06.OracleSymmetry.paperG_add_half` | theorem | L132 | Shifting the threshold by `N` negates `paperG` for positive `N` [ChildsLandahlParrilo2007]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.OrderedSearch06.OracleSymmetry.paperG_query_half` | theorem | L150 | Shifting the query position by `N` negates `paperG` for positive `N` [ChildsLandahlParrilo2007]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.OrderedSearch06.OracleSymmetry.paperG_period` | theorem | L168 | The query-position period of `paperG` is `2 * N` for positive `N`. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.OrderedSearch06.OracleSymmetry.paperG_shift` | theorem | L179 | Translating the threshold by `l` is equivalent to translating the query position by `−l` [ChildsLandahlParrilo2007]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.OrderedSearch06.OracleSymmetry.paperG_eq_ospBit` | theorem | L186 | On doubled finite indices, `paperG` equals 1 when `ospBit` is true and −1 otherwise [ChildsLandahlParrilo2007]. |
